modality_annotation_comparison.fact: Both modalities use the NIR_warped_mask validity rule; RGB input pixels are not masked. This equality alone does not prove that discarded RGB pixels are physically visible target surfaces.

classification_crop_distribution.crop_vs_detection_fact: Classification crops require >=90% material purity and >=99% validity; detector connected-component boxes allow >=10% fill. Classifier scores/accuracy do not establish localization quality.

known_quality_blockers.fact: The target labels are connected semantic material regions, not whole physical-object instances.
known_quality_blockers.implication: They do not supervise the requested whole-object boxes, regardless of model capacity.

known_quality_blockers.fact: Stored held-out detector metrics have low AP/recall for both modalities; no new evaluation was performed.
known_quality_blockers.implication: Current saved evidence does not support reliable localization.

known_quality_blockers.fact: 3939 connected-region boxes in 212 training frames; 31.28% have a short side below16 pixels at640 and59.15% have component fill below50%.
known_quality_blockers.implication: Small-region detail and semantic-component geometry limit this task. Component fill does not establish the total same-class pixel purity of a rectangle.

hypotheses_not_proven_by_this_audit: Increasing model capacity and resolution may improve validation localization; causal gain must be measured.
Applying NIR validity to unmasked RGB may create RGB supervision omissions; their visibility/impact needs a manual validation-only annotation review.

Same-material connected regions can merge touching objects or fragment one object; instance IDs are unavailable in these derived labels, so the number of such physical-instance errors is not measured.
Scene-prefix separation does not establish independent physical-object identities, sites or camera domains.

recommended_validation_only_experiments.experiment: YOLO11s at 1024 input, same GT, scene-purged train/val, same AP50/AP50-95 and class metrics.
recommended_validation_only_experiments.reason: 31.28% of train boxes have a shorter side below16px at640; increased resolution directly tests loss of small-region detail, and larger capacity tests underfitting.
recommended_validation_only_experiments.controls: Preserve current baselines and frozen test split; choose only by validation. If resources allow, separate architecture and resolution in a small controlled ablation.
recommended_validation_only_experiments.limit: This improves the region-box task only; it cannot make non-instance GT into whole-object GT.

recommended_validation_only_experiments.experiment: Separate annotation experiment: manually review train/val whole-object boxes and RGB NIR-invalid GT regions; create a versioned task-correct label subset before retraining.
recommended_validation_only_experiments.reason: Low-fill fragmented semantic boxes and shared NIR validity are directly visible in preparation code/data.
recommended_validation_only_experiments.controls: Do not overwrite current labels or compare AP across changed GT as if the metric task were identical. Keep official test untouched until a final protocol is fixed.
